free_text: Although the patient has a prior positive biopsy, the evidence strongly suggests proceeding with biopsy due to the high PI-RADS score of 5 and the significant PSA velocity of 1.64 ng/mL/yr. The retrieved PSA trend, rising from 7.9 ng/mL to 8.3 ng/mL, combined with the high PI-RADS score, provides a strong indication that the lesion has changed sufficiently to warrant further tissue sampling to guide definitive management. The statistical prior suggested deferral, but the retrieved data points toward an informative next step.
